what: Brandon alone in his rented attic doing crunches on the floor, a podcast playing from his laptop, hungry and grim.
still: A washed-out, grainy night-mode photograph from a fixed lens high in the sloping rafters of a cramped rented attic, looking down at Brandon lying on a bare floorboard patch between a single bed and a heap of unwashed laundry, mid-crunch, brows pulled together, eyelids half shut, mouth set in a flat grim line, eyes aimed at the ceiling. A laptop open on a cardboard box glows pale blue and is the only light besides a bare bulb that barely reaches the corners. Brandon is small in the frame, seen from above, with damp patches on the slanted plaster and a kettle on a window ledge. The frame is a locked, unattended wide shot with nobody operating it, and nothing on the picture but the room. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon, small in the frame from high above, does one slow crunch up and down on the floor, his brows pinched and his jaw tight, then a second shaky one. Later, he pauses at the top, lets his shoulders sag, and glances sideways at the laptop. The bare bulb flickers faintly. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: floorboards creaking under his back, a faint tinny voice murmuring from the laptop speaker, his breath puffing, the bulb buzzing. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Brandon alone in the attic shaking a protein shake and drinking it, nothing else in the room to eat, the same routine as ever.
still: A flat, low-contrast frame from a fixed wide lens bolted into the corner where the attic wall meets the sloping ceiling, looking across a tiny kitchenette shelf: Brandon stands beside a dented sink with a plastic shaker bottle tipped against his mouth, head back, brows lifted, eyelids heavy, eyes aimed at the ceiling. A near-empty cupboard stands open with one sad tin visible and nothing else. The only light is a greenish fluorescent tube over the sink and a grey dawn smear through a skylight. Colours are washed out and slightly compressed, as if recorded by a lens that nobody is watching. No writing anywhere in the frame. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon swings the shaker bottle in short hard shakes beside his ear, then tilts it back and drinks, throat working, brows low. Later, he lowers the bottle, looks into the empty cupboard for a beat, and closes it with his shoulder slumping. The fluorescent tube over the sink flickers. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: the rattle of a ball inside a plastic shaker, a long gulp, a cupboard door clacking, tube buzz. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Someone is knocking at his attic door. Brandon has frozen mid-crunch on the floor, holding completely still until they go away.
still: A high, locked, grainy night-mode view from the rafters above a rented attic's narrow door, looking down at Brandon on the floor frozen halfway through a crunch, rigid, brows raised, eyelids wide, mouth shut tight, eyes aimed at the door. His laptop on the floor beside him throws a pale rectangle of light up his arm. A strip of landing light glows under the door and two dark shoe shapes interrupt it. The frame is washed out and hazy, the door wood is chipped and painted over several times, and a clothes rail sags beside it. Nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon holds absolutely still, hovering mid-crunch, only his chest moving as knuckles knock three times on the door. Later, the shadows under the door shift and retreat, and Brandon lets out a held breath and lowers himself slowly to the floor. The light strip under the door dims as the shadow shifts. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: three knocks on thin wood, the laptop murmuring quietly, floorboards creaking on the landing and fading, his shaky breath. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: A different lonely lad in a different cheap rented room in the same town, doing the same crunches.
still: A fixed, washed-out wide view from a high corner of a different cheap bedsit above a closed kebab shop, looking down on a lad of about nineteen with a patchy moustache, a stained grey tracksuit top and one sock, mid-crunch on a thin brown carpet beside a mattress on pallets. A tall fan heater with an orange bar glows by the wall, and a wardrobe has no door. A phone propped against a mug is the only other glow. Compressed colour, grain in the shadows, a lens with no operator. No writing or numbers on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. The lad does a crunch with his hands behind his head, his face scrunched, then another, sloppier one. Later, he rolls onto an elbow and scratches his stomach, staring at the propped phone. The orange bar of the fan heater pulses. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: heater ticking, carpet rubbing against his tracksuit, a delivery moped passing outside, a groan. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Another different lad, in another bedroom across the town, alone, mixing the same protein shake.
still: A locked, desaturated view from a shelf above a door, looking down into a student-house box room where a heavyset lad in a faded football shirt and checked pyjama bottoms stands at a narrow desk, shoulders hunched, shaking a plastic bottle of powder and milk in both hands. A cheap lamp with a crooked shade lights one side of his face, and the rest is murk. Posters curl off the wall, a bin overflows with takeaway cartons, and a radiator ticks beneath a sash window with a streetlamp glow. Grain and slight blur, no operator, nothing written on the frame. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. The lad shakes the bottle hard in front of his chest, then unscrews the lid and sniffs it, his nose wrinkling. Later, he glances over his shoulder at the door, takes a swig, and gags quietly. The crooked lamp flickers once. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: powder sloshing in a bottle, a lid squeaking, a cough, a radiator knocking. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Brandon hunched close over his phone in the attic at night, typing into it, face lit by it. We cannot see the screen.
still: A locked, dim, grainy night frame from a lens fixed in the rafters of the attic, looking down on Brandon hunched on the edge of a bare mattress with his phone held close to his face, thumbs poised, brows drawn together, eyelids narrowed, lips slightly parted, eyes aimed at the device. The phone's glow is a pale cold wash on his chin and nose, and its face is turned away from us as a blur of light. The rest of the attic is almost black apart from the edge of a pillow and a mug on the floor. The colour is washed out and compressed. Nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon types with both thumbs in short bursts, his lips moving silently, then stops and stares at the phone. Later, he leans back a few centimetres, rubs his eye with the heel of his hand and shifts his weight on the mattress. The phone glow flickers across his chin as the screen changes. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: soft thumb taps, a mattress spring creaking, a faint phone buzz, wind against the skylight. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: The first guru's own video: an enormous tanned bodybuilder with a shaved head and a ginger beard, in a home gym, explaining his routine at his own camera with total confidence.
still: A webcam-quality frame, slightly too wide and sitting at chest height on a shelf, of an enormous tanned bodybuilder with a shaved head and a ginger beard standing in a garage home gym, chest forward, brows raised, eyes aimed straight at the lens, mouth open mid-sentence with total confidence. Rubber flooring, a rack of mismatched plates, a rowing machine and a mirror with a smeared handprint fill the room. A harsh white garage strip light overhead blows out the pale roller door behind him, colours bleached and compressed. No writing or numbers appear on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. The bodybuilder talks at the lens, jabbing a thick finger downward, rolling his shoulders and pointing to the rack beside him. Later, he nods slowly at his own point and flexes one arm, then grins. The garage strip light flickers faintly. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: a loud echoing garage hum, plates clinking on a rack, his shoes squeaking on rubber, a muffled indistinct boom of voice. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Brandon in a cheap gym, following that routine exactly, under a weight far too heavy for him, arm shaking.
still: A high locked wide view from a ceiling corner of a cheap council-run gym, looking down at Brandon lying on a padded bench under a loaded bar on a rack, small and seen from above, brows crushed together, eyelids squeezed, mouth stretched in a grimace, one arm visibly trembling. A cracked mirror wall, a rubber floor with peeling tape, and two empty treadmills sit behind him. Flat fluorescent tubes give a washed-out green-white light, one tube dimmer than the rest. The frame is grainy, compressed, with nobody behind the lens. No writing on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon strains under the bar with his trembling arm, his face reddening, his legs scrabbling on the bench. Later, he holds the bar at the top for a second with his arm wobbling, and a gym-goer in the distance glances over. The dim tube above flickers. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: straining breath, the bench creaking, a treadmill belt whirring in the distance, the tube buzzing. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: The moment after his arm has gone: Brandon on the gym floor holding his arm, other gym-goers turning to look. No gore.
still: A locked, washed-out wide view from a high corner of the cheap gym, looking down at Brandon sitting on the rubber floor beside a bench, clutching one arm against his chest, brows raised and bunched, eyelids pinched, mouth open, eyes aimed at the floor. Three gym-goers stand around the edges of the frame, turning their heads towards him: a man in a vest with a towel, a woman on a rowing machine, a teenager in a hoodie. The bar rests on its rack above the bench, level and still. The fluorescent tubes are flat and greenish, the mirror is cracked, and nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon rocks gently forward on the floor, holding his arm to his chest while the three gym-goers turn their heads and step slowly towards him. Later, the man in the vest lowers his towel from his shoulder and stands still, staring, while the woman stops rowing. A fluorescent tube flickers overhead. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: a low moan, a rowing machine chain winding down, trainers squeaking, tube hum. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Inside the ambulance. Brandon on the stretcher, arm wrecked and bandaged, clutching a protein shake. Sophie the paramedic reaches to take it, kind and tired.
still: A flat, bleached, slightly wide frame from a small lens mounted in the top corner of an ambulance's rear compartment, looking down along the length of the stretcher. Brandon lies on it with his arm wrapped in thick white bandage and strapped across his chest, his other hand clutching a plastic protein shake bottle, brows raised, eyelids heavy, mouth pressed shut, eyes aimed at Sophie. Sophie sits on the jump seat to his left in her green paramedic uniform, leaning in with one hand reaching for the bottle, her brows slightly lowered, eyelids tired, mouth soft. A cold white strip light above them washes out colour, and cabinets with latches and folded blankets line the walls. Nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Sophie's hand slides gently around the shake bottle while Brandon tightens his grip for a moment, then loosens it and lets her take it. Later, Brandon's head lolls back on the pillow, and Sophie sets the bottle on a shelf and tucks a blanket higher on his chest. The strip light vibrates faintly with the engine. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: engine drone, tyres on tarmac, plastic creaking as the bottle is eased free, a stretcher strap clicking. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Inside the ambulance, closer on Brandon on the stretcher, trying to speak and barely managing a sentence.
still: A grainy, bleached frame from a lens fixed above the stretcher inside the ambulance, closer, looking down at Brandon's head and shoulders on a thin pillow, his bandaged arm strapped across his chest, brows pulled up in the middle, eyelids fluttering half shut, mouth open as if starting a sentence and failing, eyes aimed at the ceiling light. A cold white strip light fills the frame, with red blanket edges and a corner of a cabinet visible at the edges. The colours are drained and compressed, nobody operates the lens, and nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon's lips part and close several times as he tries to form a sentence, his brows working and his chin trembling. Later, he gives up, closes his eyes and lets his head sink deeper into the pillow. The white strip light shudders slightly with the road. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: engine drone, a monitor beeping slowly, a stretcher rattle, a ragged breath. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Attic at night, Brandon on his bed with his arm in a cast, duvet up, facing away, sad. Nothing explicit, entirely implied.
still: A locked, murky, grainy night view from a lens high in the attic rafters, looking down at Brandon on his narrow bed, turned away from us on his side with the duvet pulled up to his ears and one arm in a white cast resting on top of the cover, the whole shape small and still. A thin line of orange from a streetlamp enters through the skylight and lies across the floorboards, and a laptop lid on the floor is closed. A mug and a pill packet sit on a crate beside the bed. The colours are washed out, there is no writing on the picture, and nothing explicit is shown. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon's shoulders rise and fall slowly beneath the duvet, then give two small shudders. Later, he pulls the cast arm closer to his chest and goes still. The streetlamp light on the floorboards flickers as a car passes. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: rain on the skylight, a sniff, the bed frame creaking, a car passing outside. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Brandon in the shared bathroom, one arm in a cast, staring at a dripping tap with his phone propped on the sink.
still: A locked, washed-out view from a lens high in the corner of a shared bathroom, looking down at Brandon standing at a chipped basin with one arm in a cast, brows pulled together, eyelids heavy, mouth slack, eyes aimed at a dripping tap. His phone is propped against the mirror on the sink's edge, its face turned away as a blur of light. The room has yellowed tiles, a mouldy shower curtain, a bare bulb in a cage, and a pile of towels on a radiator. Colours are bleached and compressed, with grain in the shadows, and nothing is written anywhere on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon stares at the tap while a drop forms and falls into the basin, and he lifts his good hand and rubs the back of his neck. Later, he leans in toward the phone, squints at it, and then straightens with his brows lifting slowly. The caged bulb hums and flickers. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: slow drips echoing on enamel, a pipe ticking in the wall, the bulb buzzing, a distant toilet flush. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: The plumbing guru's own video: a calm, kind, decent bloke in overalls kneeling by a tap in a bathroom, talking at his own camera.
still: A steady, slightly soft frame from a phone leaned on the lip of a bathtub, looking at a calm, kind man in his fifties with a weathered face and a grey stubble jaw, wearing faded blue overalls, kneeling on a tiled floor beside a basin, one hand resting on a copper pipe under it, eyes aimed warmly at the lens, mouth mid-sentence. A window with frosted glass pours flat daylight across the room and bleaches the tiles behind him. A toolbag sits open at his knee, and nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. The plumber talks to the lens with an easy nod, then taps the pipe under the basin twice with a knuckle. Later, he gestures to a valve with an open palm and gives a small reassuring smile. A soft breath of wind moves the net curtain in the frosted window. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: a knuckle knocking on copper, the metallic clink of a spanner in the toolbag, a gentle drip, a muffled murmur of voice. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Brandon has turned the wrong valve under the sink with his one good hand. Water is bursting out over him and across the floor.
still: A locked, grainy, desaturated wide view from a lens in the top corner of the shared bathroom, looking down at Brandon crouched awkwardly under the basin with one arm in a cast, his good hand on a pipe valve, brows raised, eyelids wide, mouth open, eyes aimed at the water. A fan of water bursts outward from the pipes, spreading in a bright sheet across the floor tiles and over his hoodie. A caged bulb overhead blows out the wet highlights, towels slump on the radiator, and his phone sits on the sink's edge with its face turned away. Colour is bleached, and nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Water streams outward from under the basin and spreads across the tiles while Brandon flinches back, arm raised across his face, and scrambles on his heels. Later, he slumps, kneeling in the spreading puddle, and looks up at the ceiling with his shoulders dropping. The caged bulb flickers. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: a loud hiss of pressurised water, splashing across tiles, a yelp, a pipe thudding in the wall. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Jenny in her downstairs flat, looking up in shock as her ceiling sags and collapses, water pouring through. Seen from a camera on her kitchen shelf.
still: A fixed, slightly fisheyed, washed-out view from a lens on a kitchen shelf, looking across a small downstairs flat kitchen at Jenny standing at a counter with a mug in one hand, head tipped back, brows raised high, eyelids wide, mouth open, eyes aimed at the ceiling. The plaster above her sags in a heavy brown bulge, with water streaming from a crack and splashing on the lino beside her. A pendant light swings slightly, a calendar hangs on the fridge door, and the colours are bleached with grain. Nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Jenny stares upward as the bulge in the ceiling swells and water pours from the crack into a widening puddle, and she steps back a pace with her mug lowered. Later, she turns her head toward the door and puts a hand to her mouth. The pendant light sways gently. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: heavy water pattering on lino, a plaster creak, the mug ringing against the counter, a sharp intake of breath. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: The charisma guru's own video: a shiny young man with too many teeth in a bright room, counting things off on his fingers at his own camera.
still: A bright, blown-out laptop-webcam frame of a shiny young man with too many teeth, glossy hair and a tight shirt, sitting in a white-walled room with a ring light glowing a pale halo in his eyes, one hand raised with fingers spread, counting things off, brows lifted, eyes aimed straight at the lens, a huge grin showing a row of teeth. A window behind him burns out to white, a fake plant sits on a shelf, and the colours are washed and slightly compressed. Nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. The young man ticks off three fingers one by one, nodding at each, then flashes both palms toward the lens. Later, he leans in a few centimetres, widening his grin, and raises his brows. The ring light shimmers faintly in his eyes. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: a hollow, echoing small-room hum, a chair creaking, a finger tapping a desk, a bright indistinct burble of voice. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Doorbell view: Brandon standing at Jenny's front door in a stiff, rehearsed, confident posture, saying hello.
still: A distorted, wide, bleached fisheye view from a small lens mounted at the side of a front door, looking out at Brandon on the step of a terraced house, standing stiffly upright with his shoulders thrown back, one hand raised in a rehearsed wave, brows lifted, eyelids wide, mouth stretched in a fixed smile, eyes aimed straight at the lens. His cast arm hangs by his side. A hanging basket, a wheelie bin and a wet pavement sit behind him in flat grey afternoon light, with colours washed out and grain in the shadows. Nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon waves once and raises his chin, holding the stiff smile while rocking onto his toes. Later, his smile twitches, his eyes dart sideways, and his raised hand lowers a few centimetres. The hanging basket sways in a light breeze. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: a chime ringing once, wind hissing across the lens, a car engine passing, trainers shuffling on a stone step. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Doorbell view, moments later: Brandon still standing there, the door has shut in his face, posture collapsing.
still: A distorted, wide, washed-out fisheye view from a small lens at the side of a front door, looking out at Brandon on the step of a terraced house, shoulders collapsing forward, his raised hand dropping to his side, brows tilted up in the middle, eyelids low, mouth pulled flat, eyes aimed at the door. The front door's inside edge is just shut in the foreground, a hanging basket and a wheelie bin sit behind him, and flat grey light bleaches the pavement. Grain in the shadows, nothing written on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon stands frozen for a second, then his shoulders slump and his head sags forward. Later, he turns slowly on the step, looks over his shoulder at the door, and walks out of frame to the left. The hanging basket sways in the breeze. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: a latch clicking, wind across the lens, trainers scuffing a stone step and fading, a distant dog barking. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: A cheap restaurant, seen from a camera above the till: Brandon alone at a table for two as a woman walks out of the door behind him, silently.
still: A high, locked, washed-out wide view from a lens above the till of a cheap cafe-restaurant, looking down on Brandon sitting alone at a table for two with a sauce bottle and a paper napkin in front of him, shoulders hunched, brows pinched, eyelids low, mouth tight, eyes aimed at the empty chair. Behind him, a woman in a long coat walks away through the glass door with her back to us, a bell above it swinging. Orange pendant lamps give a yellowish light, a laminated menu leans on the table, a fridge hums in the corner, and the colours are bleached with grain. Nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. The woman pushes the door open and walks out without looking back while Brandon sits unmoving, then slowly lowers his gaze to the table. Later, he picks up the paper napkin, turns it over in his hand and sets it down again. The pendant lamp above him sways slightly after the door swings. The picture is shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: a door bell jingling, the door thudding shut, a fridge humming, cutlery clinking from the kitchen. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: The face guru's own video: chadjaw7x, a man in his twenties with a ridiculously sharp jaw, in a dim bedroom, leaning into his own camera, sneering with confidence.
still: A man in his twenties with an absurdly sharp, square jaw leans in close to a webcam on a dim bedroom desk, chin lifted, one corner of his mouth pulled up in a sneer and his eyelids lowered with total confidence. The image is a soft, slightly over-compressed frame from a cheap laptop camera, with a wide-angle lens distorting his nose and forehead a little. Behind him is an unmade single bed with a grey duvet and a clothes airer hung with socks, and the only light is a bluish glow from the screen on his face plus a thin bar of orange streetlight leaking round a curtain edge. Muted, slightly washed-out colour and soft digital noise in the shadows. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. The man tilts his chin up and turns his jaw slowly to the left, then back to the lens, sneering, his eyebrows rising once. Later he leans a little closer, his shoulders rolling forward, and settles back with a slow blink. The orange light at the curtain edge flickers faintly as a vehicle passes outside. The camera does not move. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. Audio: a faint laptop fan hum, the creak of a desk chair, a muffled car passing on the street. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Brandon in the bathroom, seen from behind him and to the side, holding a hammer up near his own jaw, eyes shut, about to go. It has not touched him.
still: A high, fixed view from the corner of a small tiled bathroom ceiling looking down and slightly across at Brandon, who stands at the sink seen from behind and a little to the side, his right arm raised with a claw hammer held in his fist beside his own cheek, his eyes shut tight, his brows pulled together and his mouth clenched. The hammer has not touched him. The basin is stained, the grout is grey-brown, a plastic toothbrush mug sits crooked on a glass shelf, and a flaking window with frosted glass is above the bath. The only light is one flat white tube overhead, making the white tiles slightly green. Muted, washed-out colour with a faint grain. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon stays frozen with the hammer raised beside his face, his shoulders rising as he sucks in a breath, his eyelids squeezing tighter. Later his raised arm trembles slightly and his weight shifts from one foot to the other. The overhead tube buzzes with a very slight flicker. The camera does not move. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. Audio: the buzz of the tube light, a slow drip from the tap, a held breath, a floorboard creaking. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Sophie and a second paramedic edging down a narrow landing with their hands out, slowly, very calmly, the way you approach a dangerous animal.
still: A narrow upstairs landing in an old terraced house seen from a fixed point high at the top of the stairs. Sophie and a second paramedic, a heavy-set man with a grey crew cut and a green uniform jacket with reflective stripes, edge forward side by side along the landing, with Sophie on the left of the frame and the second paramedic on the right, both with their hands held out low and open and their knees slightly bent. Sophie's brows are raised and soft, her eyes fixed ahead and her mouth a little open. The carpet is a worn brown pattern, the wallpaper is peeling at a seam, a coat hangs from a door handle, and a bare bulb in a paper shade is the only light, with a cold blue wash coming up the stairwell from a distant doorway. Muted colour, slight grain. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Sophie and the second paramedic take two slow, careful steps along the landing with their open hands out in front of them, moving in step. Later Sophie glances sideways at her colleague and gives the smallest nod. A thin wash of blue light from the stairwell pulses slowly on the wallpaper. The camera does not move. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. Audio: slow footsteps on old carpet, the creak of floorboards, the rustle of waterproof uniform fabric, a radio crackling very quietly downstairs. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Sophie gently taking the hammer out of Brandon's raised hand on the landing.
still: A narrow landing with a worn carpet, filmed from a fixed point high in a corner near the ceiling. Sophie stands on the left of the frame and Brandon on the right, close together. Sophie's gloved hand is wrapped round the handle of a hammer in Brandon's raised hand and is gently lowering it, her brows relaxed, her eyes steady on his face, her mouth in a small calm line. Brandon's eyes are wide and wet, his brows pulled up in the middle, his mouth slack. A single bare bulb overhead lights the wallpaper, which is yellowed at the seams, and an open doorway behind them shows a dark bathroom with a white tiled edge. Washed-out, slightly compressed colour with faint grain. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Sophie's hand slides down over Brandon's fingers and slowly draws the hammer down and out of his grip, lowering it to her side as his arm drops. Later Brandon's shoulders sag and his eyes close for a moment as his head tips forward. The bare bulb hums with a faint flicker. The camera does not move. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. Audio: the hum of the bulb, the soft scrape of a handle through fingers, a shaky exhale, a floorboard creaking. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: The longevity guru's own video: a very rich, waxy, ageless man in a white glass house, with hundreds of pills laid out in front of him.
still: A very rich, waxy man of indeterminate age with unnaturally smooth, taut skin, bright white teeth and swept-back silver-blond hair sits at a long white table inside a glass house, filmed by a fixed lens placed low and near him on the table. Hundreds of pills in small neat rows of white, brown and yellow cover the table in front of him, and he holds a single capsule between thumb and finger, looking into the lens with a serene, unblinking smile. Behind him are floor-to-ceiling glass walls onto a pale lawn and a pale sky, and the light is flat, bright, overcast daylight bouncing off white surfaces, a little overexposed at the windows. Slightly over-sharpened, desaturated colours and mild compression. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. The man raises the capsule slightly, turns it to the light, and holds it up beside his face with a perfect smile. Later he lowers it and slowly turns his head to the right, then back, his expression unchanging. A tiny bird crosses the pale sky behind the glass. The camera does not move. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. Audio: a very faint air-conditioning hush, the tick of a pill against the table, a distant bird. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Brandon in the attic with a heap of cheap chemist bottles, tipping a huge handful of pills into his mouth, about to choke.
still: A high fixed view from a rafter corner of a cramped rented attic with a sloping ceiling. Brandon sits on the floor in the centre of the frame, small from above, leaning back against a stained mattress, surrounded by a heap of cheap chemist bottles and blister packs in white, orange and blue. His head is tipped back, his right hand is raised to his open mouth, his brows are pulled up and together and his eyes are watering and wide. A bare bulb on a flex hangs from a beam and a small skylight lets in a patch of dull orange night sky. Grainy night-mode texture, muted colours. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon's raised hand holds still at his open mouth while his cheeks tighten and his throat works, and his other hand grips the floorboards. Later his eyes screw shut and his head jerks forward slightly as his shoulders hunch. The bulb on its flex sways very slightly. The camera does not move. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. Audio: the rattle of plastic bottles, a wet swallow, floorboards creaking, the faint tick of the bulb swaying. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: The shared back garden: Brandon climbing into a wheelie bin full of cold water and ice from a petrol station, in his pants, teeth chattering.
still: A small, paved shared back garden at night seen from a fixed high point on the wall of the house, looking down at a large grey wheelie bin standing between a rusting rotary washing line and a cracked patio slab. Brandon, small from above, stands up to his thighs in the bin in his pants, his arms wrapped tight round his chest, his shoulders hunched, his jaw clenched and trembling and his eyes wide and fixed on nothing. Bags of ice from a petrol station lie slumped on the ground beside the bin, and the water in the bin is dark with floating cubes. The only light is a harsh yellow lamp over a neighbour's back door, which leaves most of the garden in grain and deep shadow. Muted, compressed colour. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon lowers himself slowly deeper into the bin, his arms clamped across his chest, until the water reaches his ribs, his mouth tight. Later his whole body shudders once and his head rocks back as he blows out a long breath. The yellow lamp over the back door buzzes with a slight flicker and a thin steam rises from his shoulders. The camera does not move. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. Audio: the slosh of cold water against plastic, ice cubes knocking together, chattering teeth, a distant dog barking. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Brandon in the shared kitchen, with a slab of raw liver with a yellow reduced sticker, biting it and starting to retch.
still: A cramped shared kitchen with a lino floor, a pale laminate worktop, a chipped sink full of mugs and a grease-spotted cooker, filmed from a fixed point high on top of a wall cupboard. Brandon stands in the middle of the frame, small from above, holding a slab of dark raw liver in both hands near his mouth, with a yellow reduced sticker on its plastic tray at his elbow. His brows are pinched together, his nose is wrinkled, his eyes are watering and his lips are curled back from his teeth. A single flickering fluorescent tube overhead is the only light, giving everything a cold green-white cast. Washed-out, slightly compressed colour with faint grain. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon bites into the liver and chews with his face twisting and his shoulders rising, then holds still, his cheeks bulging. Later his throat spasms and he bends slightly forward from the waist with his free hand pressed flat to his stomach. The fluorescent tube flickers. The camera does not move. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. Audio: the buzz and tick of the tube light, a wet tearing bite, laboured chewing, a fridge compressor humming. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: The testosterone guru's own video: Sun Beam, a leathery, oiled man on a sun lounger on a beach, shot chest up, talking at his own camera, utterly serious.
still: A leathery, deeply tanned man in his fifties with oiled, creased skin, a gold chain and a fixed intense stare sits on a sun lounger on a bright beach, framed chest up in the slightly wobbly, soft focus of a phone held at arm's length. He looks straight into the lens with total seriousness, and his brows are lowered and level. Behind him is a pale strip of sand, a flat grey-blue sea and a bleached sky, and the light is harsh midday sun blowing out his shoulders and the sky to white. Oversaturated skin, clipped highlights and mild compression. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. The man nods slowly and lifts his chin, then points one finger directly at the lens with a grim, unblinking look. Later he lowers the hand to his chest and rolls his shoulders once. A light breeze pushes a few strands of hair across his forehead and ruffles the edge of the lounger towel. The camera does not move. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. Audio: wind buffeting the phone microphone, waves breaking softly, a gull far off, the creak of the lounger. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: The shared back garden seen from an upstairs window far away: Brandon from behind on a deckchair, facing the sun, shorts round his ankles, legs apart. We only see his back.
still: A tiny, paved shared back garden filmed from a fixed upstairs window far away, looking down through the slightly dirty glass at Brandon from behind, small in the centre of the frame, on a faded stripy deckchair facing the sun with his shorts round his ankles and his legs apart. We only see his back and the back of his head. Around him are a rotary washing line, a few weeds in cracked paving, a wheelie bin and a low brick wall, and the light is bright midday sun casting short hard shadows. Flat, washed-out colour, a bit of reflection from the window glass in one corner and mild compression. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon leans back in the deckchair with his head tilted up to the sun and stays completely still. Later he shifts his weight and lifts one arm behind his head. A bluebottle crosses in front of the window glass and a faded tea towel on the washing line stirs in the breeze. The camera does not move. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. Audio: a faint breeze, a buzzing fly against the glass, a distant lawnmower, a creak of canvas. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Jenny at her window, her face reacting, reaching up and pulling down the blind.
still: A first-floor window in an old brick house seen from a fixed point across the garden, with Jenny standing behind the glass in the centre of the frame, her face turned towards the camera, her brows lifted high, her eyes wide and her mouth open in a small shocked O. One of her hands is raised and gripping the cord of a cream roller blind that is half down. Net curtains hang at the edge and a shelf with a small plant sits behind her, and the light is flat grey afternoon daylight with a faint reflection of the sky across the window. Slightly soft focus, washed-out colour and mild compression. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Jenny's raised hand pulls the cord down steadily and the blind rolls down over her face until the window is covered. Later the blind steadies and a faint shadow moves behind it as she steps away. A net curtain at the edge of the window stirs slightly. The camera does not move. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. Audio: the rattle of a roller blind mechanism, a distant seagull, a faint drone of traffic. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Inside the ambulance again: Brandon on the stretcher, sunburnt and wrecked, Sophie greeting him like an old friend, with a thick paper file on her knee.
still: The cramped interior of an ambulance, filmed from a fixed point high in the front corner of the ceiling, looking down the length of the vehicle. Brandon lies on the stretcher on the right of the frame, his skin red and shiny and peeling, his brows drawn together and his eyelids half closed, his mouth hanging open. Sophie sits on the left of the frame on a fold-down seat beside him with a thick paper file open on her knee, smiling warmly at him, her brows lifted, her eyes crinkled and her head tilted. A pale strip light runs along the ceiling and the cabin walls are pale grey with stowed equipment bags, and an orange glow comes from the rear window. Muted, washed-out colour with faint grain. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Sophie leans towards Brandon with her warm smile and pats the thick file on her knee with one hand, then turns a page. Later Brandon rolls his head slowly towards her and gives a long, tired blink. The strip light along the ceiling flickers as the vehicle rocks slightly. The camera does not move. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. Audio: the low rumble of an engine idling, the rustle of paper, the squeak of the stretcher, a soft rattle of stowed equipment. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: The first guru's tearful apology video: an enormous tanned bodybuilder with a shaved head and a ginger beard, crying into his own camera under a ring light, one huge hand on his chest.
still: An enormous, tanned bodybuilder with a shaved head and a thick ginger beard sits close to a camera in a home gym, crying openly, tears running down his cheeks, one huge hand pressed flat on his chest. His brows are pulled up and together, his eyes are red and shining and his lower lip is trembling. A round white ring light reflects as a bright circle in each eye and lights his face flat and bright, and behind him are a rubber-matted floor, a rack of black dumbbells and a wall mirror with a smudged corner. Slightly over-sharpened, saturated skin tones, soft compression in the dark areas. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. The bodybuilder draws in a shuddering breath, his chest heaving under his hand, and tears run slowly down his cheeks into his ginger beard. Later he bows his head, then lifts it again with his lip trembling. The bright ring light gives a faint electrical shimmer on the mirror behind him. The camera does not move. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. Audio: a wet, shaky inhale, a sniff, the hum of the ring light, the faint clink of a weight plate settling in the rack. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Brandon alone at the kitchen table, sitting with it. Very still, nothing happening. The quietest shot in the film.
still: A small, dim kitchen at night, filmed from a fixed point in the corner at head height, with Brandon sitting alone at a wooden table in the centre of the frame, his hands resting on the tabletop, his head slightly lowered, his brows relaxed, his eyelids heavy and his mouth closed, his eyes aimed at nothing on the table. A cold mug and a phone lying face down sit near his hand. The only light is a single pale pendant bulb above the table, leaving the corners dark, with a thin line of orange from the street under a closed door. Quiet, washed-out colour with fine grain. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon sits almost perfectly still, his chest rising and falling slowly, his eyes staying on the table. Later his gaze lifts for a moment towards the dark window and then lowers again with a slow blink. The pendant bulb gives the faintest flicker. The camera does not move. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. Audio: the low hum of a fridge, a slow clock ticking, a quiet exhale. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: The same table: his phone lights up beside his hand. He looks down at it. We cannot read the screen.
still: A small, dim kitchen at night, filmed from a fixed point in the corner near the ceiling, looking down on Brandon sitting at a wooden table with a cold mug and one hand resting beside his phone. The phone lies face up but turned away so that its screen is only a soft blur of pale light spilling on the tabletop and on his hands and jaw. His head is bowed, his eyebrows have lifted in the middle, his eyelids are wide open and his eyes are aimed down at the glowing phone. A single pendant bulb is off, so the phone is the only light, leaving the corners of the room dark. Washed-out colour, grainy night-mode texture. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. A pale glow washes over the table as the phone lights up, and Brandon lowers his gaze to it, his brows lifting slightly. Later his fingers tighten a little against the tabletop and he leans a few centimetres closer. The light from the phone pulses once, softly, on the wall behind him. The camera does not move. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. Audio: a short soft phone chime, the hum of a fridge, a slow breath in. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Brandon in bed in the attic at night, phone light on his face, tapping once on the screen with his thumb.
still: A photograph taken by a small unattended lens fixed in the sloped ceiling above a rented attic room, looking straight down at a single bed under the rafters at night. Brandon lies on his back with the duvet to his chest, his face lit pale blue-white from below by the phone held above him, the phone's face turned away from the lens. The rest of the attic is almost black, with grainy night-mode noise, washed-out compressed colour, and a bare floorboard gap at the edge of the frame. The angle is high, wide and flat, and Brandon is small in the frame. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon, small in the wide high view, lies still in bed with the phone held above his face, then taps once with his thumb and lets the hand drop to the duvet. Later he gives a slow blink and his brows lift slightly. The glow on his face dims a little. Night-mode grain shimmers in the dark corners of the rafters. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Soft thumb tap on glass, duvet rustle, a faint creak of rafters, a distant fridge hum from downstairs. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Morning in the attic, daylight. Brandon sitting bolt upright in bed, astonished at how good he feels, patting his own face.
still: A photograph from a webcam-style lens fixed on a bookshelf at the end of the attic, looking along the room at a single bed under a sloped ceiling in flat morning daylight. A skylight blows out to near white and the rest of the room is washed out and slightly soft. Brandon sits bolt upright in the bed, the duvet bunched at his waist, both palms flat on his own cheeks, eyes wide, brows high and mouth open in an astonished O. A mug and a crumpled hoodie sit on the floorboards by the bed. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon sits bolt upright and pats his cheeks with both palms, three quick pats, eyes wide and brows high. Later his hands drop to his lap, he looks down at himself and his mouth widens into a disbelieving grin. Dust drifts in the shaft of light from the skylight. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Quick soft palm slaps on skin, duvet fabric shifting, a pigeon walking on the skylight glass, floorboard creak. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Brandon at his desk reading a printed scientific paper, finger under the line, mouth slightly open, as if he has discovered fire.
still: A photograph from a lens fixed high in the corner of a cramped attic, looking down diagonally at a pine desk under a bare bulb. Brandon sits at the desk with a printed sheaf of paper flat in front of him, one finger under a line of text that is too small to read, his mouth slightly open and brows raised in wonder. A desk lamp with a cracked plastic shade, a cold mug and a wire pen pot crowd the desk. The light is a single warm bulb plus a grey window, with heavy grain and washed-out colour. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon slides his finger slowly along the line of the printed paper, lips parting wider as he reads. Later he looks up at the sloped ceiling with his brows high, then back down and resumes under the next line. The bare bulb flickers once and steadies. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Paper rasp under a fingertip, a slow mouth-breath, the buzz of the bare bulb, a distant bus passing outside. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Brandon at the bathroom mirror brushing his teeth at exactly bedtime, intense and committed, like a boxer before a title fight.
still: A photograph from a lens fixed high above a narrow bathroom door, looking down into a small bathroom with chipped white tiles and one fluorescent tube overhead giving flat green-white light. Brandon stands at the sink facing the mirror, a toothbrush in his mouth, his jaw set, brows pulled low and eyes locked on his own reflection with fighter-like intent. Limescale rings the tap and a damp towel hangs on a radiator. The image is washed out and compressed, and Brandon is small in the frame. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon brushes in firm, even strokes, jaw set and eyes unblinking on the mirror. Later he leans in a fraction, narrows his eyelids and gives a single sharp nod to himself. The fluorescent tube hums and flickers once. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Rhythmic bristle scrub, a tap dripping slowly, the electrical buzz of the tube, a pipe knocking in the wall. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Brandon tucking his duvet in around himself with total focus, bed made perfectly, attic now tidy.
still: A photograph from a lens fixed in the ceiling corner of the attic, looking down at a single bed in grey daylight from a small window. Brandon kneels on the mattress tucking the duvet edge tight under the mattress with both hands, brows drawn together, tongue pressed in one cheek, eyes on the corner. The bed is flat and square, the floorboards are swept and the clothes are folded in a pile on a crate. The picture is soft, washed out and a little noisy. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon tucks the duvet under the mattress with both hands along one side, smoothing it flat with a sweep of his palm. Later he sits back on his heels, looks over the finished bed and gives a small satisfied nod. A dust mote drifts through the window light. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Cotton fabric dragging over a mattress, palm smoothing, a floorboard creak, soft wind at the window. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Brandon under the bathroom sink turning a valve correctly. Nothing goes wrong. The floor stays dry. He is quietly delighted.
still: A photograph from a lens fixed high on a bathroom wall, looking down at a cramped space under a basin where a narrow cupboard door stands open. Brandon lies on his side on a dry lino floor with head and shoulders under the sink, a spanner in one hand, the other hand on a chrome isolation valve, a small torch clamped in his teeth lighting the pipes. His brows are lifted and his eyes crinkled with delight. The floor is dry and the colours are washed out. A single overhead strip light lights the room. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon turns the chrome valve a quarter turn with the spanner, then stops and looks at the pipe. Later he lifts one thumb in the air and his eyes crinkle. The overhead strip light hums. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Metal on metal, a faint tick of pipework, torch beam clicking, a quiet pleased exhale through the nose. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Brandon asleep in the tidy attic, peaceful, floss on the bedside table.
still: A photograph from a lens fixed near the ceiling at the foot of an attic bed, looking along it at night in dim night-mode grain. Brandon sleeps on his back under a neat duvet, mouth slightly open, brows smooth, eyelids closed. A strip of dental floss lies coiled on a wooden crate beside the bed next to a glass of water. A bar of streetlight orange comes through a small window and lies across the floorboards. The rest is deep shadow, washed out and compressed. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon sleeps without stirring, the duvet rising and falling with his breathing. Later he turns his head a few degrees on the pillow and his mouth closes. The streetlight bar flickers once as something passes outside. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Slow steady breathing, a faint fabric rustle, a car passing far below, a distant fox cry. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Brandon walking down a street in daylight, taps his phone with his thumb without looking at it. Seen from a shop's camera.
still: A photograph from a lens fixed above the doorway of a small shop, looking down and across a narrow pavement and a town high street in flat grey daylight. Brandon walks along the pavement past parked cars and a bin, one hand holding a phone at hip height, its screen turned away from the lens, his gaze straight ahead. Wet paving, a lamp post and brick terraces give the scene washed-out colour and slight lens distortion at the edges. He is small in the frame. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon walks across the frame from right to left at an even pace, thumb tapping the phone at his hip once without his eyes dropping from the road ahead. Later he steps past a lamp post and exits at the edge of the frame. A plastic bag stirs on the kerb. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Steady footsteps on damp paving, a car passing on the road, a pigeon wing flap, a faint thumb tap on glass. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Brandon alone at a table, head bowed over a plate of vegetables, hands together, as if saying grace.
still: A photograph from a lens fixed high in the corner of a small kitchen, looking diagonally down at a laminate table under one fluorescent ring light. Brandon sits alone at the table, head bowed over a white plate of steamed broccoli, carrots and boiled potatoes, hands pressed together in front of his chin, eyelids closed and brows slightly drawn. A single cup, a salt pot and a wipe-clean tablecloth fill the surface. The image is washed out and slightly blurry from compression. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon holds his bowed head and pressed hands very still over the plate. Later he opens his eyes, unclasps his hands and picks up a fork. The fluorescent ring light buzzes and dims faintly. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Fork tines clinking on china, a fridge motor humming, a tap dripping, a chair leg shifting on lino. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: A street seen from a fixed camera on a lamp post: Brandon jogging on the pavement, healthy, while an ambulance rolls slowly past him with Sophie in the passenger window watching him.
still: A photograph from a lens fixed at the top of a lamp post, looking down steeply at a suburban street in flat overcast daylight. Brandon jogs along the pavement, small and foreshortened from above, in a loose grey tracksuit and with an easy, upright stride, his face turned forward and calm. In the road beside him a white ambulance with a blank side panel rolls slowly past, and Sophie sits in the passenger window looking out at him with her brows drawn together and her mouth closed. Wet tarmac, a postbox and parked cars give washed-out, compressed colour. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon jogs steadily along the pavement from the left of the frame while the ambulance rolls slowly forward beside him on the right. Sophie's head turns to follow him through the window. Later Brandon jogs out of frame and the ambulance crawls on, its brake lights glowing. A leaf spins along the gutter. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Rhythmic running footfalls, a low diesel engine idle, tyres on wet tarmac, a distant dog bark. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Brandon at the gym's front door, looking down at his phone and then turning to look behind him.
still: A photograph from a doorbell-style lens fixed beside a glass door at a small gym entrance, looking out toward a rain-damp car park in wide, slightly bent perspective. Brandon stands on the step outside the front door with his head tipped down at a phone in his hand, its screen turned away, then his head is half-turned over his shoulder as if sensing something behind him, brows pinched and eyes wide. The light is overcast grey with a sodium glow in the glass behind. The colour is washed out with a hint of fisheye distortion. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon stands on the step looking down at the phone in his hand. Then he turns his head slowly over his shoulder toward the car park behind him, brows pinching. Later he blinks and shifts his weight to the other foot. A strip of rain drips from the door canopy. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Rain dripping from a canopy, a car door thunk far away, the hum of a fluorescent sign, shoe soles on a wet step. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Inside the gym: Gary in brand-new gym kit with the price tag still on, on the right, being talked at by a delighted Brandon on the left.
still: A photograph from a lens fixed high in the corner of a plain, under-lit gym room, looking down across rubber flooring, a bench and a rack of dumbbells under one flickering strip light. Brandon on the left of the frame faces right, talking with his eyebrows high and his mouth wide, one hand gesturing. Gary on the right of the frame stands stiff in a stiff, brand-new grey gym t-shirt and black shorts with a blank cardboard price tag still dangling from the hem, looking at him with a fixed, blank face. The image is soft, washed out and slightly noisy. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon, on the left, talks and gestures with his hand while Gary, on the right, stands still with his arms at his sides. Later Gary glances once toward the door and back, and Brandon keeps talking. The strip light flickers. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. A flickering tube buzz, rubber soles squeaking, a distant treadmill belt, muffled dumbbell clunks, a rustle of stiff new fabric. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Brandon sitting on a bench between sets, talking non-stop and sharing everything, on the left. Gary on the right, holding a towel, listening with no expression.
still: A photograph from a lens fixed in the corner of the ceiling of a gym changing area, looking down at a low wooden bench against tiled walls under a flat fluorescent panel. Brandon on the left of the frame sits forward with his elbows on his knees, mouth open mid-flow and brows raised, one hand open in the air. Gary on the right of the frame stands holding a folded white towel, his eyelids half-lowered and his mouth flat, gazing at nothing. Colours are washed out and slightly green, with soft grain. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon, on the left, rocks and gestures with one open hand, talking without pause. Gary, on the right, stays rigid, the towel hanging from both hands. Later Gary's eyes slide to Brandon and back to the wall. The fluorescent panel buzzes. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Fluorescent panel buzz, a distant shower drip, sneakers squeaking, a locker door clanging down the corridor. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Gary on the right handing Brandon on the left a protein shake he has made. Brandon beaming. Gary's face holds on him a beat too long.
still: A photograph from a lens fixed high on a gym wall, looking down at a juice-bar counter and a stool area under a bare tube light, in washed-out colour and grain. Gary on the right of the frame holds out a plastic shaker bottle of thick beige liquid toward Brandon on the left. Brandon beams, his brows high, his eyes crinkled and his mouth wide open, reaching with both hands. Gary's face is blank and motionless, and his eyes stay locked on Brandon. A towel is slung across the counter. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Gary, on the right, extends the shaker bottle and Brandon, on the left, takes it with both hands, beaming. Later Brandon looks down at the bottle while Gary's gaze stays fixed on Brandon's face with a blank, unblinking stare. The tube light flickers faintly. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Plastic bottle rattle, a tube light buzz, rubber soles on the floor, a distant machine whirr. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Brandon on the shared stairs, sitting, looking at his phone, then standing up with resolve.
still: Brandon sits on the third step of a narrow shared stairwell in a rented house, elbows on his knees, head bowed to the phone in his hands, its pale light the only warm thing on his face. A bare bulb on the landing above throws a hard cone of yellow light, and the walls are scuffed magnolia with a row of mismatched coat hooks and a stack of unopened post on the bottom stair. The picture is taken from a lens fixed high in the corner of the ceiling above the landing, looking down and across the stairs, a washed-out, compressed, slightly grainy video frame with muted colour and soft shadows, as if on cheap night-mode sensor footage. Brandon is small in the frame, seen from above. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon sits hunched on the stair with the phone held close, then pushes both palms on his knees and stands up in one decisive motion, his brow set, jaw tight, eyes fixed on the front door below. Later he settles his weight onto his front foot and glances once towards the door with his eyelids narrowed. The bare bulb on the landing flickers faintly. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: a bulb buzzing, a trainer squeaking on a stair tread, the creak of the banister, a distant television through a wall. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Doorbell view, same doorway as before: the door is open. Jenny in the doorway on the left, suspicious, arms folded. Brandon on the right, honest and simple, already half turning to go.
still: A wide-angle view from a doorbell mounted beside a front door, looking out at the doorway of a terraced house: the door stands open onto a dim hallway with a bicycle leaning against a radiator. Jenny stands in the doorway on the left of the frame with her arms folded and her brows pulled together, her mouth flat, eyes fixed on Brandon. Brandon stands on the right of the frame on the doorstep, his shoulders open, brows slightly raised, already half turning his body away towards the street. The lens bulges slightly at the edges, daylight from the street is blown out to white behind the doorframe, and the colour is flat and compressed with fine video noise. A chipped boot scraper and a wilted plant in a margarine tub sit by the step. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Jenny keeps her arms folded in the doorway on the left while Brandon, on the right, finishes turning his shoulders to the street and takes one step away. Later Jenny shifts her weight onto her other foot and her eyes follow him. The wilted plant sways slightly in a light breeze. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: a car passing on the road, shoes on a stone step, wind against the doorbell microphone, a bicycle bell ticking as the door shifts. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Doorbell view: Jenny stepping out of the door after him, sizing him up, a stack of leaflets in her hand, Brandon turning back.
still: The same wide-angle doorbell view, a little later: Jenny has stepped out over the threshold onto the stone doorstep on the left of the frame, a thick stack of folded leaflets in one hand, her head tilted back and her eyes narrowed as she sizes Brandon up. Brandon is on the right of the frame, his body turning back towards her, brows lifted, mouth a little open. The lens bulges at its edges, the sky behind them is a flat bleached white, the colours are washed out and compressed, and the hallway behind Jenny is a murky dark. A pair of wet wellies stands against the wall by the door. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Jenny holds the leaflets out a few inches towards Brandon with her chin lifted, and Brandon completes his turn and faces her with his eyebrows high. Later she lowers the leaflets and her eyes flick over his shoulder at the street. The wet wellies drip slowly onto the step. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: paper rustling, shoes shuffling on the stone, a dog barking down the road, the hum of a distant van. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: A community hall with stacked chairs and a biscuit table: a handful of campaigners arguing over an agenda while Brandon carries four chairs past, thrilled to be useful.
still: A draughty village community hall seen from a lens fixed high in a corner near the ceiling, looking down the length of the room. Stackable plastic chairs are piled in leaning towers against the wall, a trestle table holds a plate of plain biscuits and a catering urn, and six or seven campaigners in anoraks sit around a cluster of tables, one older woman with a ring binder, one man with his finger raised mid-argument. Brandon crosses the foreground carrying four chairs stacked against his chest, his face bright with delight, his eyebrows high and his mouth wide in a grin. The light is flat fluorescent tube light with a green cast, the colour washed out and compressed, and the floor is scuffed pale wood. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. The campaigners gesture and talk over each other at the tables while Brandon walks steadily from the right of the frame to the left carrying the stack of chairs, grinning. Later he stops, shifts the stack on his chest and looks round for where to put it, his eyes wide. One fluorescent tube flickers overhead. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: the scrape of plastic chair legs on wood, a tea urn ticking as it heats, overlapping muffled voices, a tube light buzzing. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: A cheap pub, seen from the camera over the bar: Brandon on the left listening with one finger near an earpiece, Jenny on the right talking, and staying, a second drink on the table.
still: A cheap pub on a weekday evening, seen from a lens mounted high above the bar and looking down across the room at a small corner table. Brandon sits on the left of the frame, leaning slightly forward with one finger resting beside his ear, his brows drawn together in concentration and his eyes on Jenny. Jenny sits on the right of the frame, talking with her hands open, her brows raised and her mouth mid-word. Two glasses of lager and a second round of drinks stand on the sticky table between them, with a bag of crisps ripped open flat. A fruit machine glows in the background. The light is dim orange pub lamplight, the picture is washed-out, grainy and compressed, and the bar top foreground is out of focus. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Jenny talks and gestures with her open hands while Brandon listens, his finger at his ear and his eyes fixed on her face, then nods slowly. Later Jenny picks up her drink, leans back in her chair and stays where she is, settling in. The fruit machine pulses with coloured light in the background. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: the thrum of a pub room, glasses clinking, the fruit machine jingling, a chair leg scraping on a sticky floor. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: The community hall full of people on folding chairs: Brandon standing up, speaking, and being good at it. The whole room is turned to him.
still: A community hall packed with about forty people on folding chairs, seen from a lens fixed high at the back corner of the room, looking down towards a small raised platform. Brandon stands at the front on the right of the frame with one hand held out, his chin up, his eyebrows lifted and his mouth open mid-sentence, speaking with total ease. Every head in the room is turned towards him, a sea of backs of heads, woolly hats and thinning crowns, a woman near the front leaning in with her elbow on her knee. A tea urn and a trestle table sit unattended at the side, and the strip lighting is flat and slightly green. The colour is washed out and compressed with fine video noise. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon speaks to the room with an open hand moving in a slow arc while the audience stays turned to him, and a few heads nod. Later a ripple of movement passes through the seated crowd as people lean forward and the woman near the front sits back and folds her arms, smiling. One fluorescent tube flickers over the back rows. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: a hall full of people shifting on folding chairs, a cough, the hum of a tube light, a tea urn ticking. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Attic at night, Brandon sitting on the bed typing on his phone with both thumbs, glowing with happiness.
still: A cramped attic bedroom at night, seen from a lens fixed high in the corner where the sloped ceiling meets the wall, looking down at a single bed under the eaves. Brandon sits on the edge of the bed typing on his phone with both thumbs, his whole face lifted in a broad open smile, his cheeks high and his eyes bright, lit from below by the pale glow of the phone. A rail of crumpled clothes, a stack of takeaway boxes and a small skylight with a black sky behind it fill the room. The only light is the phone and a faint orange glow from a streetlamp through the skylight, the picture is grainy night-mode footage with lifted blacks and washed-out colour. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon types quickly with both thumbs, grinning at the phone, then draws a breath and lets out a small silent laugh with his shoulders shaking. Later he lowers the phone slowly to his knee and looks up at the skylight, still smiling, his eyelids soft. The streetlamp light through the skylight flickers faintly as something passes in front of it. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: thumbs tapping glass, a mattress spring creaking, a distant car on wet road, a pipe ticking in the roof. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: A bland corporate office at night seen from a ceiling camera: a screen on a desk with one person reading it, her hand on the mouse, highlighting a line we cannot read.
still: A large bland open-plan office at night seen from a lens fixed in the ceiling directly above a row of grey desks. One woman in a cardigan, invented and ordinary, sits alone at a desk in the middle of the frame, seen from behind and above, her hand on a computer mouse and her head bent towards a monitor whose face is turned away from the camera, showing only a pale smear of light on her glasses and the desk. The rest of the room is dark apart from the green glow of a vending machine and a strip of corridor light. Grey carpet tiles, a swivel chair with a torn arm and a half-dead plant in the foreground. The colour is washed out and compressed, grainy, like a lifted dark video frame. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. The woman clicks and drags the mouse slowly down the screen, then stops, her head tilted, and holds still over one line. Later she leans back in the swivel chair and rubs the back of her neck with one hand. The vending machine light hums and pulses faintly in the dark corner. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: a mouse click, a chair creaking, the low hum of air conditioning, a vending machine compressor humming. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Attic at night, Brandon asleep and smiling, phone charging on the side table with its little light on.
still: The cramped attic bedroom at night, seen from a lens fixed high in the corner under the sloped ceiling, looking down at the bed. Brandon lies asleep on his back with the duvet pulled to his chest and a small contented smile on his mouth, his brows relaxed and his eyelids closed. On the cluttered bedside table a phone lies charging on a tangle of cable with one small white light glowing on its edge, beside a mug with a tea ring and a torn packet of biscuits. The room is nearly black apart from a faint orange wash of streetlight from the skylight, the picture is grainy night-mode footage, washed out and compressed. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Brandon breathes slowly in his sleep, his chest rising and falling under the duvet, the smile held on his mouth. Later he turns his head a few degrees on the pillow and his brow twitches once before settling. The small light on the charging phone pulses slowly. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: slow breathing, the rustle of a duvet, a pipe ticking in the roof, a faint car passing outside. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: Giles on a video call seen by his webcam, bored, eating salad, talking without looking up.
still: Giles on a video call, framed from a laptop webcam at the height of his chest, tilted slightly up, sitting at a kitchen table with a plastic bowl of salad in front of him and a fork in his hand. He looks down at the bowl rather than at the lens, his eyelids half lowered, his mouth working, his brows flat with boredom. Behind him a bookcase crowded with unmatched paperbacks and a box file fills the wall, and a window to one side is blown out to a white rectangle that bleaches the edge of the picture. The image is soft, low-resolution and compressed with blocky colour smearing, the colour washed out and slightly green. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Giles spears a forkful of salad, lifts it to his mouth and chews while his lips move in a drone of speech, his eyes still on the bowl. Later he pushes a leaf round the bowl with the fork and flicks his eyes up at the lens for a half second before dropping them again. The white window behind him brightens slightly as a cloud shifts. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: a fork scraping a plastic bowl, chewing, a fridge humming, a faint laptop fan whirr. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: A corner table in an ordinary English pub in the afternoon, empty, a half-drunk pint on it. Seen from the camera over the bar.
still: A corner table in an ordinary English pub in the afternoon, completely empty of people, seen from a lens fixed high above the bar and looking down at an angle across the room. A half-drunk pint of bitter stands on a round table with a beer mat folded under one edge, a padded stool pushed in on each side and a patch of daylight from a leaded window lying across the carpet. Brass horse-shoes on a rail, a threadbare red carpet and a dim wall lamp that is switched off. The colour is washed out and compressed, the daylight window slightly blown out, the picture grainy and soft at the edges. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. Dust drifts through the shaft of daylight over the empty table while the pint sits perfectly still. Later a shadow of someone passing the window slides across the carpet and away. A slow bead of condensation runs down the pint glass. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: a quiet room tone, a clock ticking, a distant glass clinking behind the bar, a dishwasher humming. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: A desk screen in the bland office: a file open with a small passport-style face photo we can barely see, in a dim room. Keep any lettering a blur.
still: A close high-angle view of a desk in a dim office, taken from a lens fixed in the ceiling directly above, the room lit only by the pale glow of a monitor whose face is turned slightly away from the camera, so the screen shows only a soft blur of light. In the blur a small pale rectangle, no bigger than a stamp, hints at a passport-style face photo, too small and soft to make out. The desk holds a cold mug, a wired keyboard with worn keys and a lanyard coiled beside it. Nothing legible anywhere. The picture is grainy and washed out, the corners vignetted dark and the colour compressed. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. The pale glow of the screen pulses slightly as the image on it refreshes, throwing a faint shifting light across the keyboard and the desk. Later a hand enters from the bottom edge of the frame, rests briefly on the mouse and leaves again. A thin curl of steam rises from the mug. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: a computer fan whirring, a mouse click, the hum of an air conditioner, a keyboard ticking once. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: A meeting room table with a large architectural model of a huge windowless data centre on the edge of a little model English town, water pipes in blue.
still: A meeting room table seen from a lens fixed high in the corner of the ceiling, looking down across the room. On the long table stands a large architectural model of an enormous windowless slab of a data centre, flat grey and the size of a coffee table, built on the edge of a little model English town with tiny terraced houses, a church spire and a roundabout. Blue plastic pipes snake from the slab across the green baize landscape towards a model reservoir. Around the table are empty swivel chairs and a flipchart with its pages left blank. The light is flat office strip light, the colour is washed out and compressed, and the picture is grainy with a slight fish-eye curve at the corners. Thanks.
motion: The camera does not move. A beam of weak afternoon sun creeps slowly across the model town from the left, lighting the tiny houses one row at a time. Later the fluorescent light overhead dips and recovers, and the blue pipes catch a brief highlight. A blind slat in the window ticks softly against the frame. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: air conditioning hum, a blind slat tapping, a fluorescent tube buzzing, a distant phone ringing in another room. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.

what: The community hall: Brandon on a folding chair looking pleased at his phone, as his phone lights up, campaigners working behind him.
still: A photorealistic wide frame of a draughty church-hall community room, taken from a lens bolted high in one corner near the ceiling and angled down, so the people are small and seen from above.
